column1: # The one state-root layout table for the fno state root.
# legacy_name    the file's old name at the top level of the state root.
#                A single `*` makes the row a glob (park rows only); `place()`
# new_relative_path  where the file lives after the migration, relative to
#                the state root. `-` for park rows: their destination is
# kind           sqlite | anchor | append | overwrite | marker | page | lock | park
#                anchor = the virtual graph.json; its existence probe is the
#                sibling .db. lock = deleted (or parked, for sockets) only
#                after its data file moved and a non-blocking flock succeeds.
# owner          daemon (the fno-agents daemon migrates it) | mux (the mux
#                server migrates it at its own start; the daemon skips it).
# Both crates read this file at build time: crates/fno-agents/src/state_layout.rs
# and crates/fno/src/state_layout.rs. Edit rows here, never in the Rust copies.
# The named root exceptions that STAY at the top level are documented in
# db/ - the graph, event, decision, question and approval stores and their
# logs/ - append-only logs; launchd fds keep writing the renamed inode.
# state/ - rewritten runtime state; newer mtime wins.
# mux/ - the mux server owns these; it moves them at its own start.
# The 2026-10-01 residue batch: an empty dir ensure-global-dir.sh created
# until this table landed (hooks, signals), session scratch (tmp, jobs-tmp),
# and an April foreign-tool drop whose dir carries the legacy brand with a
# leading dot, so its park row is a glob the rename guard can read. None of
